evidence.V1: Reads as a grass tuft on a mound in front, three-quarter, top and silhouette.
evidence.V2: Mound base, varied tall/short blades and lighter tip bands give a clear big/medium/small read.
evidence.V3: Blades are thick horn-like wedges and too few; the mound is a plain polygonal dome - only partly stylised.
evidence.V4: Blades have hard faceted edges and stepped tip bands; the mound rim is a visibly polygonal outline - inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Studio close-ups show stray faceting on blade sides, a hard colour step at blade tips and a hot spot on the dome.
evidence.V6: One green in three values (dark mound, mid blades, light tips); colourways hold the same structure.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material matches, but faceted horn-like blades do not read as the kit's smooth fused organic shells.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, Color white, SmoothPlastic - correct foliage flags.

artifacts: Hard stepped colour band at blade tips
top_fixes: Use more, thinner, smoothly curved blades with gradient (not stepped) tip colour
Smooth/round the mound and hide its rim slightly below ground
Spread blades more evenly around the clump so the top view is not lopsided
